request: Streamline NexusCentral around coding and research jobs plus model, provider, and runtime management; use one-question multiple-choice intake with option rationale and long-term impact, then require an explicit yes/no implementation approval.

changedConstraints: Work uses explicit Chat, Coding, and Research modes. Navigation expands to six single-purpose tabs by adding Workflows for autonomous scaled work.
Workflows is a unified control plane for recurring schedules, batch execution, and multi-agent stages; Runs retains execution history, evidence, artifacts, validation, and approvals.
Workflow authority is declared per stage as automatic, approval-gated, or manual; changed stage policies must be reviewed before revised workflows run unattended.

Router uses reusable named queue groups containing multiple model endpoints. Models are dragged from inventory into ordered configurable groups; Work modes and workflow stages target groups rather than raw providers.

Queue groups use transport-neutral FIFO claiming across direct endpoints, LAN mesh providers, and PeerJS providers. The first eligible available provider receives an atomic expiring lease; failed or expired claims requeue without duplicate completion.

NexusCentral must persist canonical context, memory, checkpoints, and artifacts independently of fallible model and harness calls. Invalid output or crashes preserve the last valid checkpoint and follow retry, fallback, approval, or failure policy without corrupting memory.
Keep remaining intake questions and choices short while retaining the main long-term tradeoff.

Memory scope is tab-specific. Work/Lab persists canonical context per conversation; new conversations remain isolated unless prior context is explicitly attached. Infrastructure tabs persist configuration and audit state, not conversational memory.
Workflow executions use isolated canonical memory with validated promotion into versioned workflow memory; promotion never rewrites source execution records.
Asynchronous intake generation uses four read-only gpt-5.6-sol workers at high reasoning effort; the foreground chat only records answers and relays the next queued question.

Asynchronous intake serves up to five questions per batch, maps one non-empty answer line per question, permits comma-separated multi-select choices within a line, records each batch atomically, continuously refills at a five-question watermark, and targets up to 100 material decisions before saturation.

Question workers consume a durable coverage map of locked, in-flight, and missing NexusCentral decision domains so refills prioritize blind spots across all six tabs, canonical state, harnesses, reliability, APIs, operations, and acceptance instead of padding the 100-question target.

Rejected terse abstract framing. Every question is now a code-grounded decision card with verified current V2 evidence, a plain-language impact statement, consequence-bearing choices, defined terms, and an explained recommendation. Questions 3-17 were invalidated without deleting provenance; provisional user directions remain staged for reframing.
Lab retains its split view. When no workspace is selected, the left pane shows only the Workspaces label and add control; folder selection and host-path entry remain behind that control.
